HEADLINE: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company in its meeting ....
MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company in its meeting held on Wednesday, the 04th day of November, 2026 at its registered office at Shiv Chamber, 4th Floor, Plot No. 21, Sector - 11, CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai - 400614, have inter-alia discussed, considered and approved the following:
1. Consider, approve and took on record the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended as on 30th September, 2026. 
2. Limited Review Report on the Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended as on 30th September, 2026.
3. Took note of the various compliances filed with Exchange for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026 as required under SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
